main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar short move per case (drift - return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and supporting difference > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual short move, larger |forecast| half minus smaller half (Welch difference)

decided_by: Mean unusual short move above 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases, and larger-minus-smaller shrinkage difference above 0.
reading: Situation = regime 'mean_reversion' (falling-profile veto passed and 10-day return < 0), re-checked from prices (10-day return < 0, 60-day return < -10 %) where the window holds enough bars and raw volume log ratio < 0 where recorded; a case is the first short bet (rise of short forecast >= 2 points from its lowest level since the last bet) in each 5-bar grid cell with a full 5-bar return in the window; the day-clustered t uses a G/(G-1) correction; the split puts |forecast| > median in the larger half and <= median in the smaller.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01076 on the check folds against +0.01316 on every fold
